select subject_ids.*, F.ID AS F_ID, F.NAME AS F_NAME, F.FILE_URL AS F_FILE_URL, F.SAVE_TYPE AS F_SAVE_TYPE, s.* from ( select a.*, case when count(1) = (#{query.pageSize} * #{query.pageNum}) then concat( '[', substring_index( substring_index( array_agg( a.sid::text ), ',',#{query.pageSize} * #{query.pageNum}), ',', #{query.pageSize}), ']' ) when count(1) > (#{query.pageSize} * #{query.pageNum}) then concat( '[', substring_index( substring_index( array_agg( a.sid::text ), ',',#{query.pageSize} * #{query.pageNum}), ',', -#{query.pageSize}), ']' ) else concat( '[',substring_index( substring_index( array_agg( a.sid::text ), ',', #{query.pageSize} * #{query.pageNum}), ',', - count(1) % #{query.pageSize}),']') end as subject_id, count(1) as total from( select tagass.order as tagss_order, tags.order as tags_order, tags.tag_text, tags."status", case tagass.master_id when #{query.masterId} then tagass.subject_order else tags.subject_order end as subject_order, s.id as sid FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN GC_USER_ACCESS_PERMISSION uap ON uap.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(S.ID::integer) LEFT JOIN GC_USER_ACCESS UA ON UA.ID = UAP.USER_ACCESS_ID LEFT JOIN GC_USER "USER" ON "USER".ID = UA.USER_ID LEFT JOIN gc_subject_association sa ON ( S.id = sa.subject_id OR s.fid = sa.subject_id ) LEFT JOIN gc_subject_tags tags ON tags.subject_id = s.id AND ( ( sa.subject_id = tags.subject_id AND tags.type = 1 AND s.master_id = tags.master_id ) OR ( tags.master_id = #{query.masterId} )) left join gc_subject_tag_association tagass on tagass.tag_id = tags.id and tagass.master_id = #{query.masterId} WHERE 1=1 and (sa.master_id = #{query.masterId} or sa.master_id is null) and (tags.close_subject::jsonb @> to_jsonb(s.id::integer)) is not true and (tagass.close_subject::jsonb @> to_jsonb(s.id::integer)) is not true AND s.state != 0
AND "USER".id = #{query.userId}
and tags."status" = 0 and (tagass."status" = 0 or tagass."status" is null)
and tags.tag_text = ANY(#{query.tagList})
GROUP BY tags.tag_text,s.id ) as a GROUP BY a.tag_text ) as subject_ids left join gc_subject s on subject_ids.subject_id::jsonb @> to_jsonb(S.ID::integer) LEFT JOIN SYS_FILE F ON F.ID = s.SUB_IMG_ID LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON v.sub_id = s.id order by coalesce(subject_ids.tagss_order,subject_ids.tags_order) asc

SELECT DISTINCT S.ID, S.MASTER_ID, S.NAME, S.DESCRIPTION, S.TYPE, S.SUB_ID, S.LEVEL, S.FID, S.ALIAS_SUB_ID, S.ORDER, S.SUB_IMG_ID, S.STATE, S.TOKEN, S.IS_PUBLIC, S.UPDATE_TIME, S.CREATE_TIME, S.INTRO_ON_OFF, S.TEMPLATE_ID, F.ID AS F_ID, F.NAME AS F_NAME, F.FILE_URL AS F_FILE_URL, F.SAVE_TYPE AS F_SAVE_TYPE FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN SYS_FILE F ON F.ID = S.SUB_IMG_ID LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON v.sub_id= s.id where s.state !=0 and s.fid =#{fid} order by S.order asc,s.create_time asc,s.id

select S.ID, SUM(F.VIDEO_LONG) as "subjectVideoDuration" FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN GC_SUBJECT S0 ON S0.FID=S.ID LEFT JOIN GC_VIDEO V ON V.SUB_ID = S0.ID LEFT JOIN SYS_FILE F ON F.ID = V.FILE_ID WHERE f.video_long >= 0
and S.ID IN
#{id}
GROUP BY S.ID

SELECT DISTINCT ON (s.id) S.ID, S.MASTER_ID, S.NAME, S.DESCRIPTION, S.TYPE, S.SUB_ID, S.LEVEL, S.FID, S.ALIAS_SUB_ID, S.ORDER, S.SUB_IMG_ID, S.STATE, S.TOKEN, S.IS_PUBLIC, S.UPDATE_TIME, S.CREATE_TIME, S.INTRO_ON_OFF, S.TEMPLATE_ID, F.ID AS F_ID, F.NAME AS F_NAME, F.FILE_URL AS F_FILE_URL, F.SAVE_TYPE AS F_SAVE_TYPE, f.thumb_nail_url as thumb_nail_url, (SELECT count( 1 ) FROM gc_video WHERE sub_id = s.id) AS videos_total_num FROM GC_SUBJECT S LEFT JOIN GC_USER_ACCESS_PERMISSION uap ON uap.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(S.ID::integer) LEFT JOIN GC_USER_ACCESS UA ON UA.ID = UAP.USER_ACCESS_ID LEFT JOIN GC_USER "USER" ON "USER".ID = UA.USER_ID LEFT JOIN gc_video v ON v.sub_id= s.id left join sys_file f on v.file_id = f.id
s.state !=0
AND s.id in
#{subjectId}
select sub.id from gc_subject sub left join gc_user_access_permission uap ON uap.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(sub.id::integer) where uap.id=#{id}

select g.fid,g.id,count(1)as videos_total_num from gc_subject g LEFT JOIN gc_video v on v.sub_id = g.id where 1=1
AND g.id in
#{subjectId}
group by g.id

select * from gc_subject
AND sub_id in
#{subId}
order by "order"

SELECT * from gc_subject s left join gc_video v on v.sub_id=s.id where v.id in
#{vid}

SELECT s.*,F.ID AS F_ID, F.NAME AS F_NAME, F.FILE_URL AS F_FILE_URL, F.SAVE_TYPE AS F_SAVE_TYPE from gc_subject s left join sys_file f on f.id = s.sub_img_id where s.id in
#{id}

select a.course_tags from ( SELECT tags.tag_text AS course_tags, tags.subject_id AS subject_id FROM gc_subject_tags tags LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id = tags.subject_id left join gc_subject_tag_association assotag on assotag.tag_id = tags.id and assotag.master_id = #{masterId} left join gc_subject_association asso on asso.subject_id = tags.subject_id where 1=1 and asso.master_id = #{masterId} AND tags."status" = 0 AND (tags.subject_id = asso.subject_id and tags.type =1 and s.master_id = tags.master_id) and assotag.id is not null and (assotag."status" = 0 ) UNION( select tag_text as course_tags,subject_id from gc_subject_tags where master_id = #{masterId} and status = 0)) as a
left join gc_user_access ac on ac.user_id = #{userId} and ac.master_id = #{masterId} left join gc_user_access_permission per on per.user_access_id = ac.id
where 1=1 and a.course_tags not in (select tag_text from gc_subject_tags where id in (select tag_id from gc_subject_tag_association where master_id = #{masterId} and "status" = 1))
and per.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(a.subject_id::integer)
GROUP BY a.course_tags

select a.course_tags from ( SELECT tags.tag_text AS course_tags, tags.subject_id AS subject_id FROM gc_subject_tags tags LEFT JOIN gc_subject s ON s.id = tags.subject_id left join gc_subject_tag_association assotag on assotag.tag_id = tags.id and assotag.master_id = #{masterId} left join gc_subject_association asso on asso.subject_id = tags.subject_id where 1=1 and (asso.master_id = #{masterId} AND (tags.subject_id = asso.subject_id and tags.type =1 and s.master_id = tags.master_id)) or( assotag.id is not null) UNION( select tag_text as course_tags,subject_id from gc_subject_tags where master_id = #{masterId})) as a
left join gc_user_access ac on ac.user_id = #{userId} and ac.master_id = #{masterId} left join gc_user_access_permission per on per.user_access_id = ac.id
where 1=1
and per.SUB_PERMISSION::jsonb @> to_jsonb(a.subject_id::integer)
GROUP BY a.course_tags

select s2.*,auc.user_id as userId, p.id as subjectAssociationId from gc_subject s left join gc_user_access_permission p on p.sub_permission::jsonb @> to_jsonb(s.id::integer) left join gc_user_access auc on auc.id = p.user_access_id left join gc_subject s2 on s2.sub_id = s.id where p.id in
#{accessId}
